mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_work_order a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.assignee_id = #{repairerId} AND a.assign_time >= #{beginTime} AND a.assign_time < #{endTime}) AS acceptCount, COUNT(1) AS finishCount, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, COALESCE(o.assign_time, o.create_time), o.finish_time))) AS avgMinutes, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM t_work_order o LEFT JOIN t_evaluation e ON e.order_id = o.id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.assignee_id = #{repairerId} AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') AND o.finish_time IS NOT NULL AND o.finish_time >= #{beginTime} AND o.finish_time < #{endTime}
